features.title: Deterministic chunk ids across runs
features.intent: Chunking identical input twice yields identical chunk ids and boundaries.
features.serves: REQ-AC1: chunking is deterministic across runs
acceptance: Chunking the same input twice produces identical chunk ids and boundaries.

features.title: Honor overlap configuration exactly
features.intent: Overlap configuration is honored exactly at every boundary.
features.serves: REQ-AC2: overlap must be exact, not approximate
acceptance: Configuring a fixed overlap produces chunks whose overlapping bytes match the configured amount at every boundary.

features.title: Handle input smaller than one chunk
features.intent: A file smaller than one chunk yields exactly one chunk with a stable id.
features.serves: REQ-AC3: small inputs must not produce zero or malformed chunks
acceptance: A file smaller than the configured chunk size yields exactly one chunk with a stable id.
